purpose: Teach: 理性/排水/導い/促し/細部/巧み/相関/ヒロイン

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、人間の、本気で、絶対、理性、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, the way you handled human reason in your paper was genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Warm, observant opening. Steady eye contact. Pause after the name — she's settling in to give real praise. Measured pace, each word weighted. Not gushing; respect delivered clearly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。古代都市の、本気で、絶対、排水、絶対、技術、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I really wanted to do justice to the ancient city's drainage systems and engineering.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Slight lift in the voice on 'justice' — she means it. Not defensive, just sincere. Pace easy, landing softly on 'engineering' like she's still thinking about it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史人物が、本気で、絶対、後継者を、絶対、導いた、絶対、過程、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And the way you traced how historical leaders guided their successors through that process — your perspective was so broad.
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly in tone. Thoughtful, taking a beat mid-sentence. Voice steady and warm. She's drawing out the point because it matters. Not flattering — analysing what she saw.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。市民を、本気で、絶対、促した、絶対、社会運動、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I tried to show how they actually mobilised people through social movements.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Direct, not overdone. A small smile in the voice — she's pleased she explained it well. Pace measured. Lands on 'movements' without trailing off.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 美術の、本気で、絶対、細部、絶対、にわたる、絶対、技法、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The detail you brought to the artistic techniques — really remarkable work.
lines.style: Engaged, lighter than before. A hint of delight in her voice at the specificity of what Sakura did. Pace picks up slightly. 'Remarkable' lands with genuine warmth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。職人の、本気で、絶対、巧み、絶対、な、絶対、技、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to show the craftspeople's actual skill — not just label it.
lines.style: Earnest, focused. Slight emphasis on 'actual' — she cares about accuracy. Calm, methodical delivery. Voice settles on 'skill' like she's proud of getting that right.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 統計の、本気で、絶対、相関、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the statistical correlations you found — I really did admire how you handled that.
lines.style: Warm, reflective. Slight nod in the voice. Pace steady and considered. She's acknowledging something specific and mature. Not overdone — genuine respect for the analytical work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。物語の、本気で、絶対、ヒロイン、絶対、像、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes, I wanted to understand how the heroine character was actually constructed across the sources.
lines.style: Thoughtful close. Voice carries the weight of real research behind it. Slight trailing-off at the end — she's satisfied but knows there's more to think about. Warm and genuine.
